title: Signal: Possible a Google service-account key literal assigned to GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY in source
scope: One line, matching a Google service-account key literal assigned to GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.
limitations: Shape-only: a 16+ character base64 or hex literal assigned to a key-material name. It cannot distinguish a working key from a rotated or test key.
fpNotes: Test fixtures and documentation examples that use the same key name with placeholder bodies are the common false positives; the rule vetoes EXAMPLE text and requires 16+ characters with a digit.
